actions: complete named physical-unit mask from configured native action channels
atomicity: off-side native checkpoint continuation, fresh observation token and monotonic revision; failed input/program action does not commit model state
checkpoint_scope: opaque handles for agents; full episode export/import only for trusted host
limitations: one reduced PWR environment only, no general model registry or EOS prototype exposure
sync worker cancellation between commands, no native interruption or hard wall-time supervisor
per-worker resource quotas, not a sandbox or authenticated multi-tenant service
full host checkpoints contain privileged internal state and are not agent observations
same compatible runtime replay, no universal cross-platform bitwise guarantee
new interface does not promote physical model validation
observations: four cached public sensor channels with units, quality and sample times
product_intent: open source for AI/RL/LLM; no clients, payments or external LLM keys required
transport: synchronous local JSON Lines, not MCP or JSON-RPC
